items.markdown:
The **Diploma of Community Services** is `a nationally recognized vocational qualification in Australia` (typically course code CHC52025). It equips you with skills for case management, team leadership, and program coordination to help vulnerable individuals and communities.[](https://ikon.edu.au/course/diploma-of-community-services/) [[1]](https://ikon.edu.au/course/diploma-of-community-services/)[[2]](https://accsc.com.au/courses/chc52025-diploma-of-community-services/)[[3]](https://www.tafecourses.com.au/courses/community-services/)[[4]](https://reachcollege.edu.au/courses/community/diploma-of-community-services/)

Course Details & Requirements

- **Duration:** Usually 12 to 18 months full-time, though self-paced online options can extend up to 24 months.
- **Work Placement:** Mandatory minimum of 100 to 330 hours of practical work placement, depending on the training provider.
- **Entry Requirements:** Usually requires you to be 18 or older, pass language/literacy assessments, and obtain standard background checks (e.g., Working with Children Check).[](https://www.tafesa.edu.au/xml/course/aw/aw_TP01554.aspx) [[1]](https://www.tafesa.edu.au/xml/course/aw/aw_TP01554.aspx)[[2]](https://accsc.com.au/courses/chc52025-diploma-of-community-services/)[[3]](https://www.tafecourses.com.au/courses/community-services/)[[4]](https://kca.edu.au/course/chc52025-diploma-of-community-services/)

Career Outcomes & Salary Graduates often work as case managers, senior youth workers, or community support coordinators. Salaries typically range from $60,000 to $95,000 AUD per year, depending on your experience and specific role.[](https://www.tafesa.edu.au/xml/course/aw/aw_TP01554.aspx) [[1]](https://www.tafesa.edu.au/xml/course/aw/aw_TP01554.aspx)[[2]](https://accsc.com.au/courses/chc52025-diploma-of-community-services/)[[3]](https://www.haderinstitute.edu.au/news/community-services-worker-salary-australia)Where to Study & Funding You can study this diploma through various TAFE institutions, universities, and private Registered Training Organisations (RTOs). Depending on your state, you may be eligible for Fee-Free TAFE or government-subsidized training. You can explore course options and enrollment paths through local providers such as [TAFE Queensland](https://tafeqld.edu.au/course/17/17679/diploma-of-community-services) or [TAFE SA](https://www.tafesa.edu.au/xml/course/aw/aw_TP01554.aspx).[[1]](https://www.westernsydney.edu.au/tertiary-education-pathways-and-partnerships/vet-categories-and-courses/community-services/diploma-of-community-services)[[2]](https://accsc.com.au/courses/chc52025-diploma-of-community-services/)[[3]](https://www.tafesa.edu.au/xml/course/aw/aw_TP01554.aspx)*Tip: A completed diploma frequently provides direct entry and academic credits toward related university bachelor's degrees.* [](https://www.westernsydney.edu.au/tertiary-education-pathways-and-partnerships/vet-categories-and-courses/community-services/diploma-of-community-services) [[1]](https://www.westernsydney.edu.au/tertiary-education-pathways-and-partnerships/vet-categories-and-courses/community-services/diploma-of-community-services)
